collision_summary: CEGIS/OGIS, synthesis modulo black-box oracles, active automata learning and proof-carrying action governance are known. ECT is not novel as generic black-box specification inference. Only its fail-closed combination with ClayCode CallContract identity/epoch/effect witnesses for the current Frank v0.1 blocker remains a project-specific novel-combination candidate.
